children: HSBC lifted its year-end target for Europe's STOXX 600 index
for the first time this year on Wednesday, citing stronger earnings growth prospects, improving business sentiment and positive growth revisions.
The brokerage expects the index to reach 680 points by the end of 2026, up from its previous forecast of 670.
